import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# Initialize PyChrono environment
chrono.SetChTypeSinglePrecision()
chrono.SetChTimeStep(1.0/30.0)  # Set time step for simulation

# 1. Initialize the physical systems and objects
# Create the world
world = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Add ground
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(100, 100, 1, 0.1, False, False)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -1, 0))
world.AddBody(ground)

# 2. Add the HMMWV vehicle
# Create HMMWV vehicle
hmmwv = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(2, 1, 1, 1000, True, True)
hmmwv.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
hmmwv.SetBodyFixed(False)
hmmwv.SetCollide(True)
world.AddBody(hmmwv)

# Set HMMWV properties
hmmwv.SetChassisColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.3, 0.3))
hmmwv.SetEngineType(chrono.ChVehicleEngineType.FOUR_WHEEL_DRIVE)
hmmwv.SetTireModelType(chrono.ChTireModelType.FRICTIONLESS)

# 3. Set default parameters
# Terrain friction and restitution
terrain_friction = 0.7
terrain_restitution = 0.0
world.SetContactMaterial(terrain_friction, terrain_restitution)

# 4. Initialize a driver system
# Create a driver system for vehicle control
driver = chrono.ChDriverSteeringWheel()
driver.Initialize(hmmwv, chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0.5, 0, 0), chrono.Q_from_AngX(chrono.CH_C_PI/2)))

# 5. Implement ROS communication
# Initialize ROS manager and handlers
ros_manager = chrono.ChROSManager()
ros_manager.Initialize()
ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chrono.ChROSHandlerClockSync())
ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chrono.ChROSHandlerDriverInputs())
ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chrono.ChROSHandlerVehicleState())

# 6. Simulation loop
while world.GetChTime() < 100:
    # Synchronize systems
    ros_manager.Synchronize()
    driver.UpdateState()
    hmmwv.UpdateState()
    
    # Advance systems
    world.DoOneStep()
    
    # Update ROS manager
    ros_manager.PublishData()
```

from pychrono import irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono as ch
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.ros as chros

def main():
    # Set the Chrono data path for vehicle data
    veh.SetDataPath(ch.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

    # Create the HMMWV vehicle and set its parameters.
    hmmwv = veh.HMMWV_Full()
    hmmwv.SetContactMethod(ch.ChContactMethod_NSC)
    hmmwv.SetChassisCollisionType(veh.CollisionType_NONE)
    hmmwv.SetChassisFixed(False)
    hmmwv.SetInitPosition(ch.ChCoordsysd(ch.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1.6), ch.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)))
    hmmwv.SetEngineType(veh.EngineModelType_SHAFTS)
    hmmwv.SetTransmissionType(veh.TransmissionModelType_AUTOMATIC_SHAFTS)
    hmmwv.SetDriveType(veh.DrivelineTypeWV_AWD)
    hmmwv.SetSteeringType(veh.SteeringTypeWV_PITMAN_ARM)
    hmmwv.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)
    hmmwv.SetTireStepSize(1e-3)
    hmmwv.Initialize()

    # Create the terrain for the vehicle to interact with.
    terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(hmmwv.GetSystem())
    patch_mat = ch.ChContactMaterialNSC()
    patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
    patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
    patch = ch.ChTerrainPatch()
    patch.SetMaterial(patch_mat)
    patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 100, 100)
    terrain.AddPatch(patch, ch.CSYSNORM, 100.0, 100.0)
    terrain.Initialize()

    # Create and initialize the driver system.
    driver = veh.ChDriver(hmmwv.GetVehicle())
    driver.Initialize()

    # Create the Irrlicht visualization system
    vis_sys = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
    vis_sys.AttachSystem(hmmwv.GetSystem())
    vis_sys.SetWindowSize(800, 600)
    vis_sys.SetWindowTitle('HMMWV Simulation')

    # Set visualization settings for HMMWV
    hmmwv.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VISUALIZATION_GEOM)
    hmmwv.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VISUALIZATION_LINE)
    hmmwv.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VISUALIZATION_SPHERE)
    hmmwv.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VISUALIZATION_WHEEL)
    hmmwv.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VISUALIZATION_TIRE)

    # Create the ROS manager and register handlers for communication.
    ros_manager = chros.ChROSPythonManager()
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chros.ChROSClockHandler())
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chros.ChROSDriverInputsHandler(25, driver, "~/input/driver_inputs"))
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chros.ChROSBodyHandler(25, hmmwv.GetChassisBody(), "~/output/hmmwv/state"))
    ros_manager.Initialize()

    # Start the simulation loop.
    time = 0
    time_step = 1e-3
    time_end = 30

    hmmwv.GetVehicle().EnableRealtime(True)

    # Irrlicht render loop setup
    render_steps = 10
    frame_render = 1

    while time < time_end:
        time = hmmwv.GetSystem().GetChTime()

        # Get driver inputs and synchronize the vehicle, terrain, and driver systems.
        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
        driver.Synchronize(time)
        terrain.Synchronize(time)
        hmmwv.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)

        # Advance the simulation for all modules by one timestep.
        driver.Advance(time_step)
        terrain.Advance(time_step)
        hmmwv.Advance(time_step)

        # Update the Irrlicht visual system
        vis_sys.BeginScene()
        vis_sys.DrawAll()
        vis_sys.EndScene()

        # Update the ROS manager to handle data publishing.
        if not ros_manager.Update(time, time_step):
            break

        # Render every frame_render steps
        if frame_render % render_steps == 0:
            print("Frame: ", frame_render)
            frame_render = 1
        else:
            frame_render += 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
